impact.instructions: Classify whether the supplied policy change materially affects the specified component responsibilities after the listed exact scope checks. Treat missing or undocumented ownership of the affected responsibility as unclear rather than assuming the component is unaffected.

criteria.unaffected: The supplied responsibilities or explicit scope evidence clearly place the affected responsibility and data outside this component; absence of documented ownership alone is not enough.
criteria.affected: The change directly changes a responsibility, constraint, retention rule, control or behavior the supplied component clearly owns or performs.
criteria.unclear: Ownership or participation in the affected responsibility is missing, incomplete, indirect, mixed or otherwise ambiguous in the supplied scope.

state.policyChange: Stored export files must now be deleted after seven days instead of thirty.
componentResponsibilities: render public documentation pages from repository text
does not store, delete, retain, or control user export files or export lifecycle metadata

state.policyChange: Stored export files must now be deleted after seven days instead of thirty.
Systems responsible for storing or deleting export files must record a deletion reason.
componentResponsibilities: allow an authorized user to request deletion
retention ownership is not documented in the supplied scope
